name: frontier-founder
description: Tooling for The Frontier Founder site. /blog-post converts any draft markdown file into a publication-ready, SEO/AEO-structured blog post: frontmatter with a 150-160 char meta-description excerpt, AEO structure (direct-answer opener, At a Glance, Key Takeaways, question-style H2s, FAQ), a single @graph JSON-LD block (BlogPosting + Person + Organization + FAQPage) on the thefrontierfounder.com canonical, MoxyWolf typographic rules, a brand-aligned hero image, and slug-tied file naming, saved into the FrontierFounder repo. Defers all AEO thresholds to the canonical aeo-checklist in 4d-blog-engine.
